[2026-05-31 12:16] Dispatch — **CHORE-75 Task 4 GREEN: MvoxNav wires AvatarMenu**.

Plan ref: Task 4 Steps 3-5.

1. Read `src/lib/components/MvoxNav.svelte`. Locate the inline avatar+name block in the signed-in branch (Tallis noted lines 79-85; the `<span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-sans text-[11.5px]">` containing the initial tile + `{userName}`).

2. Replace that block with:
   ```svelte
   <AvatarMenu name={userName} initial={userInitial} />
   ```

3. Add to imports at the top:
   ```ts
   import AvatarMenu from './AvatarMenu.svelte';
   ```

4. Gates: `pnpm test:unit -- --run && pnpm check && pnpm lint`. Expect all green (the new test + the mechanically-updated `renders brand and section tabs` test both pass).

5. Commit RED+GREEN; push (atomic chain). Use plan's commit message template + **include Tallis's mechanical-update flag** in body:
   ```
   feat(#75): MvoxNav wires AvatarMenu — avatar becomes menu trigger

   Replace the inline avatar+name block with <AvatarMenu>. User name
   now lives inside the dropdown panel (under "Signed in as"); only
   the initial tile remains visible in the navbar.

   Mechanical test update per CHORE-72 Task-15 rule: existing
   'renders brand and section tabs' test asserted hardcoded inline
   name 'Maire L.'; updated to assert the AvatarMenu trigger button
   instead. Intent preserved (signed-in user visual affordance);
   name moves into dropdown.

   Reviewed-by: Tallis (RED spec)
   ```

6. Report SHA + gate output.

Unsupervised.

[2026-05-31 12:27] Dispatch — **YELLOW-75.1 GREEN: focus the sign-out link on open**.

In `src/lib/components/AvatarMenu.svelte`:

1. Add a `signoutLinkEl` bindable element ref alongside the existing `triggerEl` + `panelEl`:
   ```ts
   let signoutLinkEl: HTMLAnchorElement | undefined = $state();
   ```

2. Bind it on the sign-out anchor:
   ```svelte
   <a bind:this={signoutLinkEl} data-testid="avatar-menu-signout" ...>
   ```

3. Inside the existing `$effect` that runs when `open === true`, add the focus call right at the top (before the keydown/mousedown handlers are registered). Use `requestAnimationFrame` or `setTimeout(.., 0)` to defer past the {#if open} mount tick if needed:
   ```ts
   $effect(() => {
     if (!open) return;
     // CHORE-75 YELLOW-75.1: focus the first menuitem on open
     signoutLinkEl?.focus();
     // ... existing keydown + mousedown listeners ...
   });
   ```

   If the focus call lands before the anchor is mounted, defer it: `queueMicrotask(() => signoutLinkEl?.focus())`.

4. Gates: `pnpm test src/lib/components/AvatarMenu.spec.ts -- --run && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm lint`. Expect 8/8 + 563+ total.

5. Commit + push (atomic chain) with this body:
   ```
   fix(#75): focus first menuitem on open (YELLOW-75.1 fold-in)

   Spec L52 required opening the menu focuses the first menuitem so
   keyboard users hit Tab → Enter → Enter (not Tab → Enter → Tab →
   Enter). Implementation previously only focused-on-Esc-close.

   3-line fold-in: bind signoutLinkEl + call .focus() inside the open
   $effect (queueMicrotask to defer past the {#if open} mount tick).

   Per Bentham YELLOW-75.1 + session-17 sub-10-line fold-in calibration.

   Reviewed-by: Tallis (RED spec) + Bentham (YELLOW-75.1)
   ```

6. Report SHA + gate output.

Unsupervised.
